Phase: To Read library Status: Complete — accepted Implementation snapshot: 2026-07-31 Starting commit: 728ae3d

This is the accepted Phase 4 record. It closes the first account-owned reader feature: one synchronized to_read set with optimistic offline mutation, durable retry, revision-based cross-device convergence, and cached metadata. It does not claim that public comments, account deletion, or the release-wide Production v0.0 definition of done is complete.

The authoritative wire, pagination, conflict, retention, and preparation behavior is recorded in the To Read library synchronization contract.

Preserved invariants

  • Guest feed, paper reading, lazy preparation, processing, Introduction, chat, Connections, and arXiv links remain independent of accounts and libraries.
  • LIBRARY_ENABLED=false publishes no library route or mobile control. LIBRARY_WRITES_ENABLED=false preserves list/change reads while PUT/DELETE fail with 503 FEATURE_DISABLED.
  • Save is available to any active account without requiring a handle, current terms, or paper preparation.
  • Library list, change, save, and remove paths perform no arXiv, PDF, GROBID, model, or preparation-queue work.
  • No global save count or cross-account watermark is observable.

Backend library model and API

Migrations 0006_library.sql and 0007_per_user_library_revisions.sql add tombstone-capable library rows, a durable operation ledger, per-user sync metadata, indexes, and shared mutation rate limiting. Revisions are allocated transactionally within one account. The forward correction safely rebases any initial global-clock data above a reset barrier, so pre-correction clients must perform one unambiguous full refresh.

The feature-gated API publishes exactly:

GET    /v1/me/library
GET    /v1/me/library/changes
PUT    /v1/me/library/{paper_id}
DELETE /v1/me/library/{paper_id}

List pagination uses an account revision fence and requires a final changes pass. Changes are ascending, include removal tombstones, and never advance for another account's activity. Tombstones are retained for 90 days; bounded cleanup advances a per-user reset floor before deletion, and an older client receives 410 LIBRARY_SYNC_RESET_REQUIRED.

Both mutation directions use one canonical client UUID. Exact replays return the canonical row; reuse for another paper or intent returns 409 LIBRARY_OPERATION_CONFLICT. Operation recording, canonical mutation, revision allocation, and rate-limit behavior are transactionally ordered. Cleanup locks per-user metadata in deterministic UUID order before child rows, avoiding its mutation race.

Every private outcome is Cache-Control: private, no-store. DTOs reject unknown or malformed state, cursor, limit, revision, operation, header, body, and paper values. Strict full-text policy masks summary capabilities without changing the paper-node save relationship. The checked OpenAPI artifact includes all four routes, bearer security, request/response schemas, headers, errors, examples, and feature-gate descriptions.

Mobile offline and identity behavior

Drift schema version 4 stores account-scoped library rows, canonical rollback state, sync checkpoints, and a durable outbox. A local mutation and operation ID commit in one transaction. The visible saved-state stream drives every paper stage and To Read copy; saves are immediate, removals offer Undo as a new operation, and pending/permanent sync states remain actionable.

The sync engine serializes per-paper work, reclaims interrupted sends after restart, preserves sent operation IDs, overlays pending intent after full replacement, applies changes transactionally, and retries retryable failures with exponential backoff, positive jitter, and the server's full Retry-After minimum. Saved paper metadata is pinned through ordinary public-cache eviction and released by remove or scoped account cleanup.

Offline display and remote authorization use separate scopes. A persisted account ID may display its cached rows while credentials refresh, but drain and refresh require an active /v1/me profile verified for the exact current auth epoch and account ID. If stored account A resolves to account B, A's rows and outbox are cleared before B binds; no A operation can be sent with B's bearer, and no B response can be committed beneath A.

The reader exposes one accessible “Save to To Read” control above the stage pager, so Abstract, Introduction, and Connections share the same state. A guest save retains one pending action through PKCE; incomplete profile onboarding is not required for save. Failure retains an explicit retry path, while system back clears the pending intent. The You branch provides an offline-first To Read list, Read navigation, refresh, remove/undo, empty, offline, pending, and error states. The Section 2.4 broad-launch enhancement added on 2026-08-03 keeps newest-saved as the default while adding local newest/oldest/title sorting, title/author/arXiv/category search, and an exact category filter. The controls operate only on the already-loaded account projection, so cached and offline lists neither issue a new request nor lose pending state.

Checks and acceptance evidence

The settled Phase 4 tree passed the following checks on 2026-07-31:

The live two-client flow began at revision zero, saved and exactly replayed one operation, synchronized it to client B, removed and exactly replayed from B, delivered the tombstone to A, replayed the older accepted save without regression, and converged both clients at revision 2. The disposable local and provider identities were removed afterward.

The acceptance paper had three pre-existing jobs and processing stage ready before the flow. It still had exactly three jobs and stage ready afterward, proving that library operations scheduled no preparation. Focused regressions also cover restart upload, offline retry, duplicate/conflicting operation IDs, 90-day reset, cache pinning, sign-out/account switch, stale HTTP completion, delayed 401 replay, and the cold-restore A→B identity race.

Exit-criteria ledger

  • Save/unsave updates immediately: accepted by the shared Drift projection and reader/list widget tests.
  • Two devices converge: accepted by deterministic cross-device tests and the live PKCE/API flow.
  • Offline save survives restart and syncs later: accepted by persistent outbox recovery and network-recovery tests.
  • Duplicate delivery creates one canonical state: accepted by service, live PostgreSQL, HTTP, and live-provider replay scenarios.
  • Tombstones and old-client reset converge safely: accepted by live database retention/reset tests and mobile full-replacement overlay tests.
  • Saved metadata survives ordinary eviction: accepted by Drift eviction, remove, and cleanup tests.
  • Write kill switch preserves reading: accepted by independent live API and route-registration tests.
  • Library performs no preparation: accepted structurally, by service/API tests, and by the unchanged live job/stage count.
  • Saved-paper sort/filter: focused widget tests cover deterministic newest/oldest/title ordering, author search, category filtering, no-result recovery, live result semantics, 48-pixel controls, 200% text reflow, and ActiveLibraryScope isolation of query, category, sort, and scroll state.

Known risks and later-phase boundaries

  • Simulator builds and source/resource inspection do not replace final signed physical-device database, secure-store, offline/restart, accessibility, and callback checks.
  • The mobile v0.0 refresh guard treats more than 1,000 pages as an inconsistent snapshot; the exact 100,000-row list ceiling is documented in the sync contract and is intentionally above the initial product scale.
  • Phase 6 account deletion must align its cascade lock order with library tombstone cleanup and include a deterministic live concurrency regression.
  • Public comments, UGC policy controls, moderation, and account deletion remain independently gated and are not made complete by this phase.

阶段： To Read 论文库 状态： 已完成 — 已接受 实施快照： 2026-07-31 起始提交： 728ae3d

这是已接受的第 4 阶段记录。它收口第一个归账户所有的阅读器功能：一个带乐观离线写操作、持久重试、基于修订的跨设备收敛和缓存元数据的同步 to_read 集合。它不声称公开评论、账户删除或适用于整个发布的 Production v0.0 完成定义已经完成。

权威的传输格式、分页、冲突、保留和准备行为记录在 To Read 论文库同步技术契约中。

保留的不变量

  • 访客 Feed、论文阅读、惰性准备、处理、Introduction、聊天、Connections 和 arXiv 链接保持独立于账户和论文库。
  • LIBRARY_ENABLED=false 不发布任何论文库路由或移动端控件。LIBRARY_WRITES_ENABLED=false 保留列表/变更读取，同时 PUT/DELETE 以 503 FEATURE_DISABLED 失败。
  • 任何活跃账户均可收藏，无需用户名、当前条款或论文准备。
  • Library 列表、变更、收藏和移除路径不执行任何 arXiv、PDF、GROBID、模型或准备队列工作。
  • 不存在可观察到的全局收藏计数或跨账户水位线。

后端论文库模型与 API

迁移 0006_library.sql 和 0007_per_user_library_revisions.sql 新增支持墓碑的论文库行、持久操作台账、按用户划分的同步元数据、索引和共享的写操作限流。修订在单个账户内以事务方式分配。向前修正会把任何初始全局时钟数据安全地重定基准到重置屏障之上，因此修正前的客户端必须执行一次明确无误的完整刷新。

启用功能门禁的 API 恰好发布以下路由：

GET    /v1/me/library
GET    /v1/me/library/changes
PUT    /v1/me/library/{paper_id}
DELETE /v1/me/library/{paper_id}

列表分页使用账户修订隔离线，并要求最后执行一次变更遍历。变更按升序返回，包含移除墓碑，且绝不会因其他账户的活动而推进。墓碑保留 90 天；有界清理会在删除前推进按用户划分的重置下限，较旧的客户端会收到 410 LIBRARY_SYNC_RESET_REQUIRED。

两个写操作方向都使用一个规范客户端 UUID。完全一致的重放返回规范行；将同一 UUID 用于其他论文或其他意图会返回 409 LIBRARY_OPERATION_CONFLICT。操作记录、规范写操作、修订分配和限流行为均按事务顺序执行。清理会先按确定性的 UUID 顺序锁定按用户划分的元数据，再处理子行，从而避免其写操作竞态。

所有私有结果的响应均为 Cache-Control: private, no-store。DTO 会拒绝未知或格式错误的状态、游标、limit、修订、操作、标头、正文和论文值。严格全文策略会在不改变论文节点收藏关系的前提下遮蔽摘要能力。已检入代码仓库的 OpenAPI 产物包含全部四个路由、Bearer 安全方案、请求/响应 schema、标头、错误、示例和功能门禁描述。

移动端离线与身份行为

Drift schema 版本 4 存储账户范围的论文库行、规范回滚状态、同步检查点和持久化待同步队列（outbox）。本地写操作和操作 ID 在同一事务中提交。可见的已收藏状态流驱动每个论文阶段和 To Read 副本；收藏立即生效，移除会作为新操作提供撤销，待处理/永久的同步状态仍可操作。

同步引擎会串行化每篇论文的工作，在重启后回收被中断的发送，保留已发送的操作 ID，在完整替换后叠加待处理意图，以事务方式应用变更，并使用指数退避、正数抖动和服务器完整的 Retry-After 下限重试可重试的失败。已收藏论文的元数据会通过普通的公开缓存淘汰保持固定，并在移除或限定范围的账户清理时释放。

离线显示和远程授权使用各自独立的作用域。已持久化的账户 ID 可以在凭据刷新期间显示其缓存行，但排空和刷新要求一个活跃的 /v1/me 资料，并针对确切且当前的认证纪元和账户 ID 完成验证。如果存储的账户 A 解析到账户 B，则会在 B 绑定前清除 A 的行和待同步队列（outbox）；绝不能使用 B 的 Bearer 令牌发送 A 的操作，也绝不能把 B 的响应提交到 A 之下。

阅读器会在阶段翻页器上方提供一个无障碍的“Save to To Read”控件，因此 Abstract、Introduction 和 Connections 共享同一状态。访客收藏会通过 PKCE 保留一个待处理动作；收藏并不要求完成资料引导。失败会保留显式的重试路径，而系统返回会清除待处理意图。You 分支提供离线优先的 To Read 列表、Read 导航、刷新、移除/撤销、空状态、离线、待处理和错误状态。Section 2.4 宽屏适配增强（于 2026-08-03 新增）保留最新收藏作为默认排序，同时新增本地最新/最旧/标题排序、标题/作者/arXiv/类别搜索和精确的类别筛选。这些控件只对已加载的账户投影进行操作，因此缓存和离线列表既不会发出新请求，也不会丢失待处理状态。

检查与验收证据

已定稿的 Phase 4 代码树于 2026-07-31 通过了以下检查：

真实双客户端流程从修订零开始，收藏并完全一致地重放了一个操作，将其同步到客户端 B，从 B 移除并完全一致地重放，把墓碑交付给 A，无回归地重放较早的已接受收藏，最终两个客户端在修订 2 处收敛。随后删除了一次性的本地身份和提供商身份。

验收论文在流程开始前已有三个预先存在的作业和处理阶段 ready。流程结束后它仍然恰好有三个作业且阶段为 ready，证明论文库操作没有调度任何准备。聚焦回归还覆盖重启上传、离线重试、重复/冲突的操作 ID、90 天重置、缓存固定、退出登录/切换账户、过期的 HTTP 完成、延迟的 401 重放，以及冷恢复 A→B 身份竞态。

退出标准台账

  • **收藏/取消收藏立即更新：**由共享的 Drift 投影以及阅读器/列表组件测试验收。
  • **两台设备收敛：**由确定性跨设备测试和真实 PKCE/API 流程验收。
  • **离线收藏在重启后存活并稍后同步：**由持久化待同步队列（outbox）恢复和网络恢复测试验收。
  • **重复交付只产生一个规范状态：**由服务、真实 PostgreSQL、HTTP 和真实提供商重放场景验收。
  • **墓碑与旧客户端重置安全收敛：**由真实数据库保留/重置测试和移动端完整替换叠加测试验收。
  • **已收藏元数据在普通淘汰后存活：**由 Drift 淘汰、移除和清理测试验收。
  • **写紧急关闭开关保留阅读能力：**由独立的真实 API 和路由注册测试验收。
  • **Library 不触发任何准备：**从结构上、由服务/API 测试以及未改变的真实作业/阶段计数验收。
  • **已收藏论文排序/筛选：**聚焦组件测试覆盖确定性的最新/最旧/标题排序、作者搜索、类别筛选、无结果恢复、真实结果语义、48 像素控件、200% 文本回流，以及 ActiveLibraryScope 对查询、类别、排序和滚动状态的隔离。

已知风险与后续阶段边界

  • 模拟器构建和源代码/资源检查不能替代最终签名的真机数据库、安全存储、离线/重启、无障碍和回调检查。
  • 移动端 v0.0 刷新守卫会把超过 1,000 页视为不一致的快照；精确的 100,000 行列表上限记录在同步契约中，并有意高于初始产品规模。
  • Phase 6 的账户删除必须使其级联锁定顺序与论文库墓碑清理保持一致，并包含一个确定性的真实并发回归。
  • 公开评论、UGC 策略控件、内容审核和账户删除仍保持独立门禁，不会因本阶段而变为已完成。
